data.query: "Santorini Pools" Garland lawsuit OR complaint OR scam

reviews.text:
I’ve been using Santorini pools for a month now and the experience has been fantastic. Elaine is always available to answer any questions that I have and the service by far is truly a red carpet experience. I’ve hired other companies in the past and it’s been a ripoff.

Elaine from Santorini Pools exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for excellent service.
reviews.author: Denis Joseph

reviews.text: I recommend Santorini Pools to anyone in everyone with a pool! We’ve had a troublesome pool since we purchased our house (chipping bottom), various hardware issues, and Elaine has helped us immensely. Each week after our service we marvel at how clean and bright it is. Elaine is friendly, warm, knowledgeable and efficient. Highly recommend !
reviews.author: Sandra Sharber

reviews.text: I can’t recommend this pool service highly enough! From the start, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and reliable. They transformed my pool into a sparkling oasis and have kept it pristine ever since. Whether it’s routine maintenance or addressing specific issues, they’re always thorough and efficient. What stands out most is their attention to detail and willingness to go above and beyond—whether it’s balancing the chemicals perfectly or ensuring my equipment is running smoothly. Their friendly demeanor and excellent communication make the entire process seamless. If you’re looking for top-notch pool care, this is the team to call!
reviews.author: OMAR VARGAS

reviews.text:
Excellent Service! Santorini Pool Cleaning is awesome! I can't say enough good things about the pool service provided by Elaine! I tried several other companies before and always felt like I was being ripped off for the service I got. But Elaine has been a pleasure to work with and for the service we get the pricing is so much more reasonable compared to other companies. It's evident she values her customers and takes the time to ensure the pool is well maintained.

Not only does she do a great job with the weekly clean, but she goes the extra mile to address small issues before they escalate. Her proactive approach has saved us both time and money in the long run.

Overall, I'm super happy with the pool cleaning service. Elaines professionalism, affordability, and commitment to excellence sets her apart from other services I've used, so If you're looking for a reliable and trustworthy pool cleaner, i recommend Santorini Pools
reviews.author: Ben S

reviews.text: I’ve used a few pool services and Santorini pools is the best! She is always on time and will update you the day prior and every appointment I get pictures along with my chemical levels and what was added. Give them a try you won’t regret it!
reviews.author: Michael Stephens

reviews.text:
Absolutely wonderful; the best. I happened to see Ms. Elaine driving around in her car with her business number and decided to give it a try. It was the best decision. She’s nice, considerate, takes photos and gives updates on your pool. She’s turn my ugly green pool into a beautiful clear normal pool, and has been coming weekly since.

Thank you, Ms. Elaine!
reviews.author: Lewis T.

reviews.text: Elaine has been taking care of my pool for almost a year now and I couldn’t be happier with her weekly service! She is extremely knowledgable and very fair with her prices. I also appreciate how honest she is about her recommendations and never tried to upsell or pressure me into anything. Every week, she takes readings of the chemicals before and after treatment, vacuums the debris, and sends me an overview of everything she did/added. 10/10 recommend!!
reviews.author: Emily Bender

reviews.text: Elaine of Santorini Pools has been cleaning my pool for almost a year. I am thrilled with her most efficient, timely, dedicated and professional pool cleaning and needed maintenance . I would highly recommend Santorini Pools and know it will measure up to the highest expectations.
reviews.author: Walid Daniel

reviews.text:
Santorini pools is a great service! Elaine keeps our pool looking good and ready for whenever the kids and I want to jump in. We tried maintaining it ourselves but that was very stressful. She comes in once a week and makes it look easy! From cleaning and keeping the water balanced to fixing whatever goes wrong with the equipment it’s all taken care of! At the end of every visit she gives me numbers and keeps me updated.
Thanks so much for your consistency! Our pool always looks great!
reviews.author: Monica Guarneri

reviews.text:
Santorini Pools has the integrity I've been looking for in pool service.They were very clear about what to expect from their service and quick to address all my concerns regarding equipment issues.
Been with them now for a little  over a year and very happy with their quality of cleaning.
reviews.author: elizabeth vasilopoulou

reviews.text: We have used several pool companies over the years, all with very disappointing service.  We found Santorini Pools a few months ago and couldn't be happier.  Elaine is very communicative, knowledgeable and on top of things.  We highly recommend her to anybody looking for their pool serviced, she won't disappoint!
reviews.author: Caitlin Zematis

reviews.text:
Elaine does an incredible job on our pool. I did my own for 7 years until finally deciding to hire someone this year. Couldn’t be happier. The pool is always in great shape despite the heavy tree coverage of our yard. She also sends a really informative text after each cleaning with details on what the readings were and what chemicals she used.

Great service at a wonderful price.
reviews.author: Ernie W

reviews.text: Elaine has been doing our pool since last year. She is amazing. I love that she texts me every time she is there with details on the treatments to the pool and recommendations if needed. She is very knowledgeable and friendly.
reviews.author: Anali Morales

reviews.text: I called them to clean my pool that had turned green and she use chemicals and vacuumed the algae and nastiness out, clean my filter and paid her $435 plus $165 in advance for the first month, two weeks later pool is looking green again and she stopped answering my texts or calls, I don't appreciate her being so RUDE. I had to pay other company to clean the filter again and do the process again.
reviews.author: Lorena Torres

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Santorini Pools and the incredible job they do at  maintaining my pool.  For the last few months now, they’ve been keeping my pool sparkling clean and crystal clear, and I'm so grateful for her hard work and dedication.
reviews.author: Alex Ramos

reviews.text: Elaine Santorini’s Green to Clean service does EXACTLY what it promises! My pool’s filter broke and it took four weeks to get it repaired through a warranty. That coupled with the relentless rain, storms, and fallen leaves left my pool a disgusting dark green for the first time ever. I tried to get it clear myself, but only succeeded in wasting a lot of money. Elaine mapped out a plan for getting the pool back in usable form and it happened exactly as promised and for an incredibly reasonable cost. She is exceptionally hardworking, a great communicator, a professional, and just an all-around superb human. I give Santorini Pools my highest recommendation!
reviews.author: Lauren Roberts

reviews.text:
Best cleaning I have ever had, with a great price to match the quality of service. She clear with what is happening and what she will be doing. Detailed information about what went into the pool, always easy to talk to and get a hold of. She worth her price and she’s even goes above and beyond with her customers service. Please just try her out your self and you will see the what I am talking about.
(Edit: previous post seemed to be taken down)
reviews.author: Alex Lopez

reviews.text: Santorini pools have really saved my pool. My pool was losing its  normal readings, I had tried some other companies to balance its acidity and alkanity all to no avail until I met Ms. Elaine. My pool's readings are now on point. Thank you, Santorini pools.
reviews.author: jeny chika

reviews.text: Excellent service! I’ve been using Santorini Pools for my filter cleaning and repairs for the last couple years. They are always very quick to send someone out as soon as I report any issue and their pricing is very competitive. Strongly recommend them!
reviews.author: shawn self

reviews.text:
Always show up and take care of my pool . My pool now always shine and blue like the ocean . You won't go wrong getting Santorini Pool company . This company don't try to get rich on any repairs and quick service.
Thanks alot !
reviews.author: Danny Petrea

reviews.text: The service from Santorini pools is exceptional. They are knowledgeable, very professional and very competitive with the cost of their services. I have no reservations giving them my recommendation.
reviews.author: Carlos Lugo

reviews.text: Absolutely great pool cleaning service.  Very friendly and easy to work with.  I would definitely recommend this company to anyone and everyone looking for a professional pool cleaning service.  My pool was a mess and now it looks a million times better.  I really enjoyed the five star service!
reviews.author: Hank Willis

reviews.text: I no longer even think about pool cleaning and maintenance now that I found this knowledgeable and courteous service
reviews.author: Jerry

reviews.text: This company has taking my pool since last year. They always kind and professional their work. I love this company.
reviews.author: 윤성희

reviews.text: My pool girl she is friendly, and efficient keep my pool clean
reviews.author: Ruben Rios

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience with Elaine!! Very professional and great service!!
reviews.author: Alyssa Yates

data.summary: The 27 Google reviews for Santorini Pools are overwhelmingly positive and consistent in praising a specific employee (Elaine) for weekly pool maintenance service. The reviews feel authentic in their detail and varied personal expression, but the perfect 4.9 rating from a modest number of reviews all within a similar recent period, with no negative feedback, warrants slight caution. There is no evidence of fake review patterns like copied text or suspicious author profiles.
fake_signals: All reviews posted within a similar timeframe (~1 year ago)
High praise with minimal specific project detail variation
authentic_signals: Mentions of specific services (weekly cleaning, chemical balancing, equipment checks)
Mentions of prior negative experiences with other companies for comparison
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review source (Google) is available. No contradictory ratings from other platforms were found.
